correctness.rationale: Reconstructed both adjacency matrices and used exact integer characteristic polynomials and finite-field matrix arithmetic (replay: python /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 2, Python 3 with SymPy). Both give (z+1)^16(z-1)^15(z^2-z-32). The -1 nullity sequences modulo 3 are (17,18,18,18) and (16,17,18,18), with +1 nullity constantly 15. The exceptional-component sum equations give dimensions 6,7,8 for the powers of A_E+I and dimension 5 for ker(A_E-I), so this is not inferred from cospectrality. Scalar extension preserves the Jordan data. On a Jordan block of length m the wave polynomial becomes a single-root degree-2m polynomial and the eigenspace is one-dimensional (v is fixed by u in the eigenvector equations), hence a single Jordan block of length 2m. In characteristic 3 the unipotent nullity at t is min(2m,3^v_3(t)); negative blocks contribute only at even t. The fixed-space dimensions replayed at 1,2,3,6,9,18 are (17,32,35,65,36,66) and (16,31,33,63,36,66), consistent with the all-time formulas. The largest positive blocks require a factor of 9 and the negative blocks a factor of 2, giving sharp order 18. Möbius inversion on its divisors gives the stated period-18 counts; unequal time-one counts rule out permutation conjugacy. The computation verifies integer and prime-field data; the Jordan argument covers all extensions, without enumeration of configurations.
